e.body:
**AAE（Actuarial Association of Europe，欧洲精算协会）** 是**欧洲各国精算协会的伞状组织**，其自述定位为「**促进精算职业的角色、声誉与认可度**」。本条目补的是**「区域伞状专业组织」这一形态**——实测池内 **AAE 本身相关条目为 0**，但**池内已收一条 AAE 的立场文件**（[[aae-ai-act-position]]，AAE 对欧盟 AI 法案的立场）——**即「有它的文件、没有它的机构条目」**，这正是本条的补位点。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **86.6KB**，页面标题实测含 **「Promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession」**；⭐ **「European standards of actuarial practice（欧洲精算实务准则）」页 `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/`（70.6KB）**；⭐ **成员协会名录 `/about-the-aae/members/`（76.4KB）**（欧洲各国协会的集合入口，可与池内 [[ifoa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]、[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]、[[assa]] 等国家级团体对照）；**出版物 `/papers/`**；⭐ **刊物《The European Actuary》`/publications/the-european-actuary/`（66.5KB）**；另有 **AAE Media**、**Member value**、**Board reports to Member Associations** 与 **Members only** 区域。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「专业标准层」这一形态**——池内已有**监管层**（欧盟 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 的政策立场、[[asf-romania]] 等成员国监管）与**国家专业团体层**（[[ifoa]]、[[institut-des-actuaires]]、[[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]），但**「跨国的专业实务准则由谁制定」这一层此前没有**；**AAE 的 European standards of actuarial practice 正是这一层**，与 IAIS 的国际原则（[[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]）形成**「国际原则 → 欧洲实务准则 → 国家标准」**的三级结构。**② 成员协会名录是现成的欧洲精算生态地图**——用于**跨国报考、互认与职业流动**研究时，可以直接看到**哪些国家有协会、名称如何**；**③ 刊物《The European Actuary》**是了解**欧洲精算行业议题**的连续来源，可与 [[european-actuarial-journal]]（学术期刊）、[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[geneva-papers]] 并读——**一个是行业刊物、一个是学术期刊**，性质不同。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、欧洲精算实务准则页、成员协会页与刊物页的存在、标题与页面体量**，**但未打开任何准则文本或刊物文章**，因此**不能转述准则的具体条款与编号**；**② 站点设有 Members only 区域**，**会员内容的范围本次未核实**；**③** 本次**未核实 AAE 与 IAA（国际精算协会）及各国家标准的具体对应关系**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算软件或数据。**核实说明**：首页（86.6KB）、`/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/`（70.6KB）、`/about-the-aae/members/`（76.4KB）、`/publications/the-european-actuary/`（66.5KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开准则文本或刊物文章**。
e.body_en:
**The AAE (Actuarial Association of Europe)** is **the umbrella body of Europe’s national actuarial associations**, describing its mission as "**promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession**". This entry adds the "**regional umbrella professional body**" form — a measured search found **zero entries for the AAE itself**, although the corpus already holds **one AAE position paper** ([[aae-ai-act-position]], its stance on the EU AI Act) — i.e. **its documents were present but its institution was not**, which is precisely the gap this entry fills.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **86.6KB** with a **measured title containing "Promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession"**; ⭐ the **"European standards of actuarial practice" page `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/` (70.6KB)**; ⭐ a **member-association directory `/about-the-aae/members/` (76.4KB)** (the collective entry point to Europe’s national associations, comparable with national bodies already in the corpus such as [[ifoa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]], [[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]] and [[assa]]); **publications `/papers/`**; ⭐ the magazine **The European Actuary `/publications/the-european-actuary/` (66.5KB)**; plus **AAE Media**, **Member value**, **Board reports to Member Associations** and a **Members only** area.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "professional standards layer"** — the corpus already had the **regulatory layer** (EU [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], the policy stance in [[aae-ai-act-position]], member-state supervisors such as [[asf-romania]]) and the **national professional-body layer** ([[ifoa]], [[institut-des-actuaires]], [[instituto-de-actuarios-espanoles]]), but **"who sets cross-border professional practice standards" had no entry**; **the AAE’s European standards of actuarial practice is exactly that layer**, forming with the IAIS international principles ([[iais-icp]], [[iais-gimar]]) a three-level structure of **international principles → European practice standards → national standards**. **② The member directory is a ready map of the European actuarial landscape** — for work on **cross-border qualification, mutual recognition and professional mobility**, it shows directly which countries have associations and what they are called; **③ the magazine The European Actuary** is a continuous source on **European actuarial industry issues**, readable alongside the academic journals [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[annals-of-actuarial-science]] and [[geneva-papers]] — **an industry magazine and an academic journal are different things**. 

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the homepage, the European standards page, the members page and the magazine page**, **but opened no standards text or magazine article**, so **the specific clauses and numbering of the standards cannot be restated**; **② the site has a Members only area**, and **the extent of member-only content was not verified**; **③** the **mapping between the AAE, the IAA and national standards was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial software or data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (86.6KB), `/about-the-aae/european-standards-of-actuarial-practice/` (70.6KB), `/about-the-aae/members/` (76.4KB) and `/publications/the-european-actuary/` (66.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no standards text or magazine article was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**AAE（Actuarial Association of Europe，歐洲精算協會）** 是**歐洲各國精算協會的傘狀組織**，自述定位為「**促進精算職業的角色、聲譽與認可度**」。本條目補的是**「區域傘狀專業組織」這一形態**——實測池內 **AAE 本身相關條目為 0**，但**池內已收一條 AAE 立場文件**（[[aae-ai-act-position]]）——**即「有它的文件、沒有它的機構條目」**，正是本條的補位點。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **86.6KB**（標題含「Promoting the role, reputation, and recognition of the actuarial profession」）；⭐ **「歐洲精算實務準則」頁（70.6KB）**；⭐ **成員協會名錄（76.4KB）**；**出版物 `/papers/`**；⭐ **刊物《The European Actuary》（66.5KB）**；另有 **AAE Media**、**Member value**、**Board reports** 與 **Members only** 區域。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「專業標準層」**——池內已有**監管層**與**國家專業團體層**，但**「跨國專業實務準則由誰制定」此前沒有**；與 IAIS 國際原則形成**「國際原則 → 歐洲實務準則 → 國家標準」**三級結構；**② 成員協會名錄是現成的歐洲精算生態地圖**（跨國報考、互認與職業流動研究可直接使用）；**③ 刊物《The European Actuary》**是歐洲精算行業議題的連續來源，可與 [[european-actuarial-journal]] 等**學術期刊**並讀（**行業刊物與學術期刊性質不同**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**四個頁面的存在、標題與體量**，**但未打開任何準則文本或刊物文章**，故**不能轉述準則條款與編號**；**② 設有 Members only 區域，會員內容範圍未核實**；**③ AAE 與 IAA 及各國標準的對應關係未核實**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算軟件或數據**。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開準則文本或刊物文章**。
